name: moment-1-undo
title: Undo one task
caption: A task deleted notes.md by mistake; Undo task removes only that task's layer, and Time Machine shows the other tasks' layers still in place. Real app, scripted tasks, sped up 1.3 times.

name: moment-2-blocked
title: The booby-trapped page
caption: A task allowed to reach only example.com reads the page, then tries attacker.example and a raw IP address; the box refuses, raises a notification, and the task window shows the blocked step in red. Real app, scripted agent acting out the hijack.

name: moment-3-approval
title: A pause for your OK
caption: A task asks to spend $15.00 on a $10.00 budget; the request lands on the box screen and the phone at once, Approve on the phone, and the box screen shows it already approved on the phone. Real app, scripted task, test money.

name: moment-4-power-cut
title: Pull the plug
caption: The box and every task process are killed at once; the screen shows the boot screen while it starts on the same data, then Welcome back: 3 tasks resumed, 0 paid twice. Real app, scripted tasks.

name: shopper
title: Shopper: buy only after your tap
caption: A watch on Hario filters under $7.00 sees the price drop to $6.50, asks to buy 2 for $13.00 as a TEST PAYMENT, and pays at the GurtOS Test Store after Approve. Real app, Stripe test mode, no real money.

name: credit-desk
title: Credit desk: the fraud hold waits for the controller
caption: A quick run of the credit desk: CRS (sandbox, live) fails APP-1043's identity, the analyst puts it on fraud hold and waits for the controller, who approves on the box screen; the window then shows the decision and its rules. Scripted seats call the real tools with no model, so they do not look for the planted errors; the live Droid run caught 16 of 17 (run bd5c61). Test identities only.
